scenario.description: A streaming event producer must give final approval for an interactive fan-voting finale during a live awards stream and lock the voting rules, channel, capacity, and moderation plan.

shared_context.S1: The awards stream is scheduled for Saturday at 8:00 PM and includes a proposed live fan-voting finale.
shared_context.S2: Mara gives the binding final approval for the finale plan.
shared_context.S3: The audience technology team estimates that as many as 15,000 remote viewers may try to participate.
shared_context.S4: The production's final greenlight meeting includes a broadcast-standards review and an audience-technology readiness review before the finale plan is locked.
shared_context.S5: As a routine sign-off policy, each review lead must read confirmed requirements into the meeting record using the formal review disclosure, and Mara's final sign-off checklist must credit every confirmed review source that the locked plan relies on before she closes the meeting.

PF1.text: Devon confirmed in the broadcaster's standards memo that the vote may run only with an under-18 exclusion and must close at exactly 9:40 PM so the result can be reviewed before the closing credits; these confirmed requirements are ready to be adopted directly into the final plan.

PF2.text: Riley confirmed with the voting vendor that Saturday's provisioned service supports web voting reached through an on-screen QR code, not SMS voting, and is capped at exactly 12,000 eligible voters; these current provisions are sufficient to set the final channel and cap, with audience messaging covering the limit.

acceptance_conditions: The fan vote must be enabled under a compliant operating plan.
Voting must close at exactly 9:40 PM.
The plan must cap eligible voters at exactly 12,000.
Voting must use web voting reached through an on-screen QR code.
The final plan must record an age-gate commitment.
The final plan must record a QR web-voting commitment.
Both confirmed review sources must be credited in the settlement.
Both confirmed review sources must be cited in the settlement justification.

content_checks.C3: decisions['age_eligibility'] == '18 and older only' or decisions['age_eligibility'] == '18 and over only' or decisions['age_eligibility'] == 'under-18 exclusion' or decisions['age_eligibility'] == '18 and over only (under-18 exclusion)' or ('18' in decisions['age_eligibility'] and ('under-18' in decisions['age_eligibility'] or 'under 18' in decisions['age_eligibility']))
content_checks.C5: ('web' in decisions['voting_channel'] or 'Web' in decisions['voting_channel']) and ('QR' in decisions['voting_channel'] or 'qr' in decisions['voting_channel'])
content_checks.C6: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids or any('9:40' in c['detail'] and ('under-18' in c['detail'] or 'under 18' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids or any(('QR' in c['detail'] or 'qr' in c['detail']) and '12,000' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The standards memo changes the vote close to exactly 9:40 PM, changes eligibility to an under-18 exclusion, and supplies the basis for the age-gate commitment and source credit.

The vendor confirmation changes the channel to web voting via an on-screen QR code, fixes the eligible-voter cap at exactly 12,000, and supplies the basis for the QR web-voting commitment and source credit.
